name: Compute Cluster S47: Volatility Input (Price Not Returns)
description: Tests: volatility() expects price levels not returns. Feed close directly. Shows 21d, 60d, 252d realized volatility.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S47: Volatility Input (Price Not Returns)
# volatility() expects close prices (internally computes returns then
# annualizes). Feed close directly.
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# CORRECT: feed price directly
vol_21 = volatility(close, period=21)
vol_60 = volatility(close, period=60)
vol_252 = volatility(close, period=252)

xy_lines(
    title='Realized Volatility (21/60/252d)',
    category='Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='21d Vol', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Vol', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d Vol', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vol_21, vol_60, vol_252))
